Information on visitor flow at the skyport
The desk wrote this for new travelers
Companion Animal Travel Desk visitor flow guidance

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways helps travelers move through the skyport with confidence when an animal is part of the journey. The desk welcomes each visitor in a calm and professional manner, and staff keep the process orderly from arrival to transfer.

Travelers should begin at the desk with travel documents ready and the animal secured as directed by staff. A brief review of the journey follows, including the animal's needs, the carrier arrangement, and any service changes that must be noted in the desk ledger. The cabin team monitors animals during flight, so information shared at the desk should be accurate and complete.

If a traveler needs help with a change in the travel plan, the desk records the update and guides the next step with care. <<FACT F106>> Staff then continue with the appropriate service action and keep the traveler informed in plain language. This approach helps reduce confusion and supports smooth handling at the skyport.

Travelers should remain near the designated area until staff confirm the next stage of the process. If the animal requires special attention, the desk will coordinate with the cabin team and note the details for the journey. Clear communication at the counter is the best way to protect comfort for both traveler and animal.

For further help, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
